description: Header file defining auxiliary functions, data structures, and method prototypes for handling PostScript fonts within the FreeType project, including parsing, table management, and glyph building.

methods.name: ps_table_new
methods.description: Creates a new PostScript table with specified count and memory management.

methods.name: ps_table_add
methods.description: Adds an object to the PostScript table at a specified index.

methods.name: ps_table_done
methods.description: Finalizes and cleans up the PostScript table.

methods.name: ps_table_release
methods.description: Releases resources associated with the PostScript table.

methods.name: ps_parser_skip_spaces
methods.description: Skips whitespace characters in the PostScript parser.

methods.name: ps_parser_skip_PS_token
methods.description: Skips a PostScript token in the parser.

methods.name: ps_parser_to_token
methods.description: Converts parser input to a token.

methods.name: ps_parser_to_token_array
methods.description: Extracts multiple tokens into an array.

methods.name: ps_parser_load_field
methods.description: Loads a field from the parser into objects.

methods.name: ps_parser_load_field_table
methods.description: Loads a table of fields from the parser.

methods.name: ps_parser_to_int
methods.description: Converts parser input to an integer.

methods.name: ps_parser_to_bytes
methods.description: Extracts bytes from parser input.

methods.name: ps_parser_to_fixed
methods.description: Converts parser input to a fixed-point number.

methods.name: ps_parser_to_coord_array
methods.description: Converts parser input to an array of coordinates.

methods.name: ps_parser_to_fixed_array
methods.description: Converts parser input to an array of fixed-point values.

methods.name: ps_parser_init
methods.description: Initializes the parser with buffer limits and memory.

methods.name: ps_parser_done
methods.description: Finalizes the parser.

methods.name: t1_builder_init
methods.description: Initializes a T1 font builder.

methods.name: t1_builder_done
methods.description: Finalizes a T1 font builder.

methods.name: t1_builder_check_points
methods.description: Checks if the builder can add a specified number of points.

methods.name: t1_builder_add_point
methods.description: Adds a point with coordinates and flag to the builder.

methods.name: t1_builder_add_point1
methods.description: Adds a point with coordinates to the builder.

methods.name: t1_builder_add_contour
methods.description: Adds a contour to the glyph being built.

methods.name: t1_builder_start_point
methods.description: Starts a new point at given coordinates.

methods.name: t1_builder_close_contour
methods.description: Closes the current contour.

methods.name: t1_decrypt
methods.description: Decrypts a buffer with a seed, used in font data processing.
